newsitem.title: EGYPT: Interbank Egypt average pound 3.3858/3.3890 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Interbank Egypt average pound 3.3858/3.3890 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Cairo banks quoted the dollar at 3.3830 to 3.3890 pounds bid and 3.3850 to 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market on Thursday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3858 pounds bid and 3.3890 pounds offered. The averages compared with Wednesday's 3.3872 and 3.3903 pounds.
Some bankers said that the market was flush with dollars as investors continued to exchange them for pounds to buy into the Egyptian securities market.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) at 3.390453 buy and 3.396740 sell. -- Cairo newsroom +20 2 578 3290/1
